prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Switch Data Merge Protection Hint: Displays an explicit sign-in hint explaining how to log into existing pet accounts safely without resetting data. (why: 8 support tickets mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Initialization Diagnostic Status: Displays real-time diagnostic status checks on the waiting screen while pet assets prepare to launch. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, and support received 3 emails about pets failing to appear on desktop.)
2: [home, notification] Desktop Spawning Sound & Notify Toggle: Adds an audio chime toggle on the waiting screen to alert users when the desktop pet finishes rendering. (why: The waiting step mean time is 5815s overall finish with high waiting times; users switch windows and miss when rendering completes.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Layout for Welcome Experience: Swaps the initial story screen layout to story_scroll with animated mascot preview elements. (why: 20.1% of users drop off at choose_path / story step within 8 seconds; interactive scrolling engages users immediately.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Tray & Hide Instructions Copy Update: Updates the home_intro headline and body to explicitly instruct how to hide and summon the pet via system tray. (why: Support received tickets regarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet once setup finishes.)

Addresses long wait times causing window switching; notification chime alerts returning users, though audio controls require moderate UI work.
